summary.text: Elliott Neff is the Republican candidate for the South Dakota House of Representatives, District 6, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A business founder, he is a National Master in chess and founded Chess4Life in 2005, according to a Ballotpedia survey.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Neff said he founded Chess4Life in 2005 to bring problem-solving and other life skills to children, and that he left Washington State in April 2021 to raise his family in South Dakota.
He described himself as a small business owner with several years of experience in the trades.
Neff said his campaign messages include protecting freedom and addressing the cost of living, citing the rise in Washington State's sales tax over his time there.
He said he believes government should be transparent and that waste should be reduced rather than relying on more taxes.
